text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Little lamb, regarding the upcoming 
training... How about we make it a menu 
that doubles as a change of pace?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
A special training session that can only 
be done in the virtual world!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Due to time constraints, we can only visit 
one location. Choose carefully.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go to the "Kingdom of 
Magic"! An unknown world! Unknown common 
sense! It's guaranteed to be great 
stimulation!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
How about the "Animal Grassland"? By 
interacting with them and observing them— 
we might discover the secret to their 
speed.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
I propose "Dungeon Conquest." An 
exploration of ancient ruins. It can forge 
stamina.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All of them are proposals impossible to 
fulfill in the real world. Since I get to 
experience it—

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Look! Cars are flying through the sky! And 
right next to them, there's even a 
dragon...!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
This world is overflowing with the 
unknown!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Come! Learn the unknown, know the world. 
Do that, and you will naturally come to 
understand yourself.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
First off, let's chase down that dragon! 
Follow my lead, little lambs!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*click!*)

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
My, how skillful! You captured the sharp 
expression of the cheetah setting out to 
hunt splendidly.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Next, let us discover the secret to the 
cheetah's speed from that photograph. 
Through this, your observant eye will—

text_block_list.name: Lion
text_block_list.text: ROOOAAAR!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Do they all want their heads 
patted? Fufuh... Then, shall we take a 
short break?

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Now! The opponent has flinched! Seize your 
chance for victory!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Good, well done. ...Look at the window 
above your head.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
How is it? Seeing your own growth 
visualized is quite intriguing, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Your daily practice takes root just like 
this. Continue to apply yourself 
diligently hereafter. —Now, begin 
advancing!
